About This Engine

TITANE is a governed, local-first AI research assistant. It prioritizes privacy and determinism.

Features include:

  • Offline-first operation
  • Deterministic text extraction
  • Governed network access
  • Sandbox-only writes

Technical Details

The architecture follows a 4-ring model: Types → Engines → Services → Modules.

Rate limiting & robots.txt respect are enforced by default.

All data is stored in data/research/ only.

Security

No JavaScript execution. No external API calls from UI. All network goes through FetchService — the single gate.
